specs.name: Zip & Unzip
specs.tagline: Open ZIP, RAR, 7z and TAR files, and make password-protected ZIP or 7z archives — on Mac, Windows and Linux, or by asking your AI.

actions.label: Extract
actions.description: Unpack a ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR or ISO into a folder. Existing files are kept: new copies get a number.
actions.mcpDescription: Extract an archive (ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR/GZ/XZ, ISO, …) on the user's computer into outDir. Give `password` for encrypted archives (it fails instead of prompting if one is needed). Existing files are not overwritten unless existing='a'.

fields.label: Password (only if the archive has one)

actions.label: Create ZIP / 7z
actions.description: Pack files (and optionally a folder) into a ZIP or 7z archive, with an optional password.
actions.mcpDescription: Create a ZIP or 7z archive on the user's computer from files and/or a folder, optionally password-protected (7z: AES-256; ZIP: AES-256 by default, or classic ZipCrypto for compatibility with Windows Explorer).

options.label: Classic (weak, but opens in Windows Explorer)

actions.label: See what’s inside
actions.description: List the files in an archive without extracting it.
actions.mcpDescription: List the contents (names, sizes, dates) of an archive on the user's computer without extracting it.

fields.label: Password (only if the archive has one)

actions.label: Check for damage
actions.description: Test that every file in an archive can be read (and that the password is right).
actions.mcpDescription: Test an archive's integrity (and password) on the user's computer without extracting.

fields.label: Password (only if the archive has one)

specs.name: Image Compressor
specs.tagline: Shrink photos and images for email, websites and upload limits — compress, resize and convert to JPG or WebP, a whole folder at a time.

actions.label: Compress images
actions.description: Make photos and images smaller. Compressed copies go to a folder you choose; originals stay untouched.
actions.mcpDescription: Compress, resize and/or convert image files (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF) on the user's computer. Writes compressed copies (same file names) into outDir; never modifies originals or overwrites existing files. Use mode=size with maxSize (bytes) to fit upload limits. File dates are kept by default (keepDates).

fields.label: Keep original file dates
fields.help: So photos keep their place in timelines after upload.

fields.label: Save compressed copies in
fields.help: Pick an empty or new folder. Originals are never changed, and existing files are never overwritten.

actions.label: Compress a folder
actions.description: Compress every image in a folder (and optionally its subfolders) in one go.
actions.mcpDescription: Compress, resize and/or convert every image in a folder on the user's computer, optionally including subfolders (folder structure is kept). Copies go to outDir; originals are never modified. File dates are kept by default (keepDates).

fields.label: Keep original file dates
fields.help: So photos keep their place in timelines after upload.

fields.label: Save compressed copies in
fields.help: Pick an empty or new folder. Originals are never changed, and existing files are never overwritten.

specs.name: Clean Up Voice Recordings
specs.tagline: Remove hiss, hum and background noise from voice memos, interviews, lectures and calls — offline, on your own computer.

actions.label: Remove background noise
actions.description: Pick a voice recording or video. Background noise is removed and a clean copy is saved; your original is not changed. Best for speech (memos, interviews, lectures, calls), not music.
actions.mcpDescription: Remove background noise (hiss, hum, fans, traffic, room noise) from a speech recording on the user's computer — any audio or video file — offline, and save a cleaned .wav copy (16 kHz mono, optimised for speech). Use whenever the user wants to clean up, denoise or improve the audio of a voice memo, interview, podcast, lecture, call or video narration. Combine with transcription for better transcripts of noisy audio.

specs.name: Send Big Files
specs.tagline: Send files or whole folders of any size to another computer with a short code. Encrypted, no account, no size limit.

actions.label: Send files
actions.description: Pick files or folders, press Send, then give the code phrase shown below to the receiver. Keep this window open until the transfer finishes.

fields.label: Custom relay (optional)
fields.help: Leave empty to use the public relay. Both sides must use the same relay.

actions.label: Send text
actions.description: Send a short piece of text, such as a link or a password, to another computer.

actions.label: Receive
actions.description: Enter the code phrase the sender gave you and choose where to save.
actions.mcpDescription: Receive files sent with croc: give the code phrase from the sender and a destination folder. Existing files are kept (renamed) unless existing="overwrite".

specs.name: Spreadsheet & Data Toolkit
specs.tagline: Open, convert, combine and analyse big CSV, Excel, Parquet and JSON files — millions of rows in seconds, on your own computer.

actions.label: Look inside a file
actions.description: See the columns, a preview of the first rows, and per-column stats (types, empty cells, min/max, unique values) of any CSV, Excel, Parquet or JSON file — even huge ones.
actions.mcpDescription: Inspect a local data file (CSV/TSV, Excel .xlsx, Parquet, JSON) without loading it into the chat: returns the first rows and per-column statistics (type, nulls, min, max, distinct count) as Markdown tables. Use this before writing a query.

argv.sql: SELECT * FROM {input} LIMIT {rows}; SUMMARIZE SELECT * FROM {input};

actions.label: Convert
actions.description: Turn CSV into Excel, Excel into CSV, or either into Parquet or JSON.
actions.mcpDescription: Convert a local data file between CSV, Excel (.xlsx), Parquet and JSON. Writes a new file; the original is not changed.

fields.label: Save as file
fields.help: Use the extension that matches the format (.xlsx, .csv, .parquet or .json).

actions.label: Combine files
actions.description: Stack many CSV files (e.g. monthly exports) into one table. Columns are matched by name, so files with different column orders still line up.
actions.mcpDescription: Combine several local CSV files into one file (rows stacked, columns matched by name; missing columns become empty). Output format CSV, Excel, Parquet or JSON.

fields.label: Save as file
fields.help: Use the extension that matches the format (.xlsx, .csv, .parquet or .json).

argv.sql: COPY (SELECT * FROM read_csv({inputs}, union_by_name = true)) TO {out} (FORMAT {format});

actions.label: Remove duplicates
actions.description: Save a copy with exact duplicate rows removed.
actions.mcpDescription: Write a copy of a local data file with exact duplicate rows removed (CSV, Excel, Parquet or JSON in; chosen format out).

fields.label: Save as file
fields.help: Use the extension that matches the format (.xlsx, .csv, .parquet or .json).

actions.label: Ask with SQL
actions.description: Answer questions about your data with SQL — totals, filters, joins across files. Refer to files by path in single quotes, e.g. SELECT region, sum(amount) FROM '/path/sales.csv' GROUP BY region.
actions.mcpDescription: Run DuckDB SQL over local data files and get the answer as a Markdown table. Read files by quoted path: SELECT * FROM '/abs/path/file.csv' (also .xlsx, .parquet, .json; globs like '/dir/*.csv'). Use for totals, filters, group-bys, joins across files on data too big to paste into chat. Results are capped by the row limit; to save results use COPY (query) TO '/abs/out.xlsx' (FORMAT xlsx, HEADER true).

fields.label: SQL

specs.name: Rename Many Files
specs.tagline: Rename hundreds of files at once — numbering, find and replace, photo dates. Preview first, undo any time.

actions.label: Find & replace
actions.description: Nothing is renamed until you tick “Apply changes”. Run once to preview the table of old → new names.

fields.label: Find
fields.help: A regular expression unless “Plain text” is ticked. Use .* to match whole names.

fields.label: Replace with
fields.help: Leave empty to delete the match. Variables: {f} original name, {ext} extension, {%03d} counter 001, 002…

actions.successMessage: Done. If you previewed, tick “Apply changes” and run again.
actions.mcpDescription: Bulk-rename files in a folder by find & replace (regex unless literal=true; variables like {%03d} counter and {ext}). Without apply=true it is a dry run that returns the old→new table — show it to the user before applying.

actions.label: Undo last rename
actions.description: Reverse the most recent rename applied in a folder.
actions.confirm: Undo the last rename in this folder?
actions.mcpDescription: Undo the most recent rename that was applied in this folder.

specs.name: Video Toolkit
specs.tagline: Shrink videos for email or Discord, convert video and audio, pull out MP3s, even out volume, make GIFs and trim clips — on your own computer, no uploading.

actions.label: Compress / convert to MP4
actions.description: Make a video much smaller (or turn any video into a widely playable MP4). Lower quality and smaller size = smaller file.
actions.successMessage: Done — compare the new file size in the folder.

actions.label: Extract audio (MP3)
actions.description: Save just the sound of a video as an MP3 — for music, lectures or podcasts.

actions.label: Convert audio
actions.description: Convert any audio (or the sound of a video) to MP3, M4A, WAV or FLAC — and optionally even out the volume so quiet recordings are easy to hear.
actions.mcpDescription: Convert an audio or video file's sound to mp3, m4a, wav or flac. normalize=true applies EBU R128 loudness normalization (loudnorm) — good for voice recordings and podcasts.

fields.label: Save as
fields.help: Use the matching extension, e.g. talk.mp3

actions.label: Make a GIF
actions.description: Turn a short part of a video into a good-looking animated GIF.

fields.label: Start at
fields.help: Where the GIF begins. Seconds (e.g. 12.5) or hh:mm:ss.

actions.label: Trim
actions.description: Cut out a part of a video instantly, without re-encoding (no quality loss). Cuts snap to the nearest keyframe.

actions.label: Add subtitles to a video
actions.description: Puts an .srt subtitle file into a video as a subtitle track (viewers can switch it on/off). The video is not re-encoded, so it’s fast and keeps full quality.
actions.mcpDescription: Add an .srt subtitle file to a video on the user's computer as a selectable subtitle track in a new MP4 (no re-encoding, full quality, fast). Use after transcribe_subtitles when the user wants captions inside the video file.

actions.label: Fix volume (normalize loudness)
actions.description: Makes quiet or uneven recordings sound loud and even — like a podcast or YouTube video. Works on audio and video; the picture is not touched.
actions.mcpDescription: Normalize the loudness of an audio or video file on the user's computer (EBU R128 loudnorm): makes quiet or uneven recordings loud and consistent at a chosen target (podcast/YouTube −14/−16 LUFS, broadcast −23). Video is copied unchanged. Use whenever the user says audio is too quiet, too loud, uneven, or wants it 'normalized' or 'podcast-ready'.

specs.name: Google Photos → Immich
specs.tagline: Move your Google Photos Takeout or any photo folder into your Immich server, keeping albums, dates and locations.

actions.label: From Google Takeout
actions.description: Select all the Takeout .zip files Google gave you. Try a dry run first: it reports what would be uploaded without changing anything.

fields.label: Immich API key
fields.help: Create one in Immich: Account Settings → API Keys.

fields.label: Also upload files that have no Google metadata

actions.mcpDescription: Import Google Photos Takeout .zip files into an Immich server (keeps albums, dates, GPS). dryRun defaults to true: run it first and report the summary before uploading for real.

actions.label: From a folder
actions.description: Upload every photo and video in a folder and its subfolders.

specs.name: Document Converter
specs.tagline: Convert Word, Markdown, HTML, EPUB, ODT and RTF documents into each other — e.g. Word to Markdown for ChatGPT or Claude, or Markdown notes to a Word file.

actions.label: Convert
actions.description: Choose one document (or several, which are joined in order) and the format you want.
actions.mcpDescription: Convert documents between formats with Pandoc (input format is detected from the file extension: .docx .md .html .epub .odt .rtf .txt .tex). Several inputs are concatenated in order. Use to='gfm' to turn Word/HTML into Markdown for reading or editing.

fields.label: Save as
fields.help: Give the file the matching extension, e.g. report.docx or notes.md.

actions.label: Write a document
actions.description: Type or paste Markdown (# headings, **bold**, - lists, tables) and save it as a Word, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, web page or e-book file.
actions.mcpDescription: Create a real document file on the user's computer from Markdown you write (pass the full text in `text`): Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx — each `## heading` starts a new slide), OpenDocument (.odt), HTML, EPUB or RTF. The `out` file extension should match `to`.

fields.label: Text (Markdown)
fields.placeholder:
# Meeting notes

**Decisions**

- Ship on Friday
- Budget approved

actions.label: Merge
actions.description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order listed.

actions.label: Split

actions.label: Compress

actions.description: Protect a PDF with AES-256 encryption.

actions.description: Remove the password from a PDF you have the password for.

actions.description: Save selected pages as separate PDF files.

actions.label: List form fields
actions.description: Shows every fillable field in a PDF form (names, current values, checkboxes) as JSON — the starting point for filling the form.
actions.mcpDescription: List the fillable fields of a PDF form on the user's computer (text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, dates) with their names, ids and current values, as fill-ready JSON. ALWAYS call this first when the user wants a PDF form filled in (applications, tax forms, contracts, registration or intake forms); then put the user's answers into the 'value' entries and pass that JSON to pdfcpu_form_fill.

fields.label: Also save the field list as (optional)

specs.name: Text to Speech
specs.tagline: Turn any text into a natural-sounding voice recording — voiceovers, narration, audiobooks — privately on your own computer, no subscription.

actions.label: Text to speech
actions.description: Type or paste text and pick a voice. Works offline — everything it needs is included in the app.
actions.mcpDescription: Turn text into natural-sounding English speech and save it as a .wav audio file on the user's computer, offline (Kokoro voices; no account, no cloud). Use this whenever the user wants a voiceover, narration, podcast intro, audiobook chapter, announcement, or wants a document/notes read aloud or 'saved as audio'. Write or clean up the script first, then pass it as `text` (up to ~20,000 characters per call; split longer documents into chapters and call once per chapter). Pick `voice` to match the request (US/UK, female/male).

specs.name: Transcribe Audio & Video
specs.tagline: Turn recordings, voice memos, meetings and videos into text — with timestamps, in 90+ languages, privately on your own computer.

actions.label: Transcribe
actions.description: Pick any audio or video file. Works offline — everything it needs is included in the app.
actions.mcpDescription: Transcribe an audio or video file on the user's computer (mp3, m4a, wav, mp4, mov, …) to text with Whisper, offline. Returns the full transcript (optionally with [hh:mm:ss] timestamps) and can also save it to a .txt file (`out`). Set `translate` to get an English translation instead. Use this whenever the user wants a recording, voice memo, meeting or video turned into text, notes or a summary.

specs.name: PDF Maker
specs.tagline: Turn text into beautifully typeset PDFs — reports, letters, invoices, CVs. Your AI writes it; Typst makes the PDF, right on your computer.

actions.label: Write a PDF
actions.description: Paste or type a document in Typst markup (headings with =, *bold*, _italic_, - lists) and save it as a PDF.
actions.mcpDescription: Create a typeset PDF file on the user's computer from Typst markup you write (pass the full document in `source`). Typst syntax: `= Heading`, `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `- item`, `#table(columns: 2, [a], [b])`, `#set page(paper: "a4")`, `#set text(font: "New Computer Modern")`. Built-in fonts work offline. Relative image paths resolve inside `assets`.

fields.label: Document (Typst markup)
fields.placeholder:
= Quarterly report

Revenue grew *12%*.

- Item one
- Item two

fields.label: Folder with images (optional)
fields.help: Only needed if the document includes images by file name.

actions.label: Typst file → PDF
actions.description: Turn a .typ file into a PDF. Images and other files next to it are found automatically.
actions.mcpDescription: Compile an existing .typ (Typst) file on the user's computer to PDF.

specs.name: AI Image Upscaler
specs.tagline: Enlarge photos and pictures 4× with AI — sharper, clearer, ready to print — privately on your own computer.

actions.label: Upscale an image
actions.description: Pick a JPG, PNG or WebP. The picture is enlarged 4× and AI fills in sharp detail. Uses your graphics card (most computers from the last ~8 years); large images can take a minute.
actions.mcpDescription: Upscale/enhance an image on the user's computer 4× with Real-ESRGAN AI (offline): makes small, blurry or low-resolution photos and pictures larger and sharper, e.g. for printing, wallpapers or old photos. Input JPG/PNG/WebP; saves a new image (format from the output file extension). Choose `model` 'anime' for drawings, cartoons and anime art, otherwise 'photo'. Needs a GPU with Vulkan support (most computers from the last ~8 years).

specs.name: Vocal Remover
specs.tagline: Split any song into an instrumental (karaoke) track and a vocals-only (acapella) track — offline, on your own computer.

actions.label: Remove vocals
actions.description: Pick a song or video. You get two files: the music without vocals (instrumental / karaoke) and the vocals on their own. Works offline — everything it needs is included in the app.
actions.mcpDescription: Separate a song (any audio or video file on the user's computer) into an instrumental/karaoke track with the vocals removed and a vocals-only (acapella) track, offline with the UVR MDX-Net model. Saves two .wav files. Use whenever the user wants to remove vocals, make karaoke or a backing track, get an instrumental, or isolate/extract vocals or an acapella from a song. Takes roughly the song's length to run.
